accords.name: Sun on the Trellis
accords.inspiration: Warm wood and leaf, the vines themselves rather than the fruit.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Beta-Damascone leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Damascone's dark sweetness against benzoin's own warmth.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Cold Stone Nave
accords.inspiration: The main hall, unheated and enormous.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Frankincense (Olibanum) leads, Cedarwood support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Frankincense over dry cedar — architecture rendered as scent.

accords.name: Myrrh on the Altar
accords.inspiration: The other resin, bitterer and less forgiving than frankincense.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh and frankincense together, the classic pairing this whole room is built from.

accords.name: Candle Smoke, Just Snuffed
accords.inspiration: The thin trail that rises the second a flame goes out.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Frankincense (Olibanum) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Frankincense's smoke meeting labdanum's warmth as it fades.

accords.name: Crypt Air
accords.inspiration: Colder and older than the rest of the building above it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh and cypriol, resin gone quiet and mineral.

accords.name: Beeswax and Stone Dust
accords.inspiration: Candles that have dripped on the same flagstone for a century.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Sweet resin over labdanum, warm against everything cold around it.

accords.name: Cold Marble Floor
accords.inspiration: Underfoot, permanently a few degrees colder than the air.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cedarwood leads, Frankincense (Olibanum) + Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Cedar, frankincense and cypriol, structured and entirely without warmth.

accords.name: Thurible Swing
accords.inspiration: Incense on a chain, sweeping the whole aisle in smoke.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Frankincense (Olibanum) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) + Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. The full triad — frankincense, cypriol and labdanum — moving as one.

accords.name: Vestry Cupboard
accords.inspiration: Where the vestments are kept, closed for most of the week.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh and labdanum, deepened by cypriol's own mineral chill.

accords.name: Ash Wednesday
accords.inspiration: The one day this room fills, and everyone leaves marked by it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cypriol (Nagarmotha) leads, Guaiacol (1%) + Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Smoke and resin, cypriol's guaiacol edge against labdanum's warmth.

accords.name: Empty Pews
accords.inspiration: Wood worn smooth by generations who are no longer here.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cedarwood leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Cedar and peat, the quietest pairing in the whole collection.

accords.name: Cut Hay, Still Warm
accords.inspiration: Hay stacked an hour after cutting, heat still in it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) leads, Linalyl Acetate support. Coumarin's own hay-note pushed further by linalyl acetate's green top.

accords.name: Grain Dust in Sunlight
accords.inspiration: Motes hanging visible in a single shaft of light.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Lavandin Grosso leads, Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Lavender-hay against coumarin — the classic combination, kept dry.

accords.name: Threshing Machine Oil
accords.inspiration: The machinery itself, oiled and running all day.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cardamom Oil RCO leads, Delta-Decalactone (wishlist) support. Spice against milky sweetness, cardamom carrying most of the weight.

accords.name: Chaff on the Wind
accords.inspiration: Husks blown clear of the grain, drifting across the yard.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Linalyl Acetate leads, Lavandin Grosso + Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Green-citrus lavandin and linalyl acetate, both anchored to bergamot.

accords.name: Barn Loft
accords.inspiration: The upper floor, stacked to the rafters until spring.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) + Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Hay-sweet coumarin over damp stone, cypriol keeping it from turning too sweet.

accords.name: Milled Flour
accords.inspiration: Grain reduced to powder, fine enough to hang in the air.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Gamma Nonalactone (Aldehyde C-18) leads, Cardamom Oil RCO + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Milky gourmand gamma nonalactone against cardamom and vanilla.

accords.name: Sacking and Twine
accords.inspiration: Rough cloth sacks, tied off and stacked for transport.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Delta-Decalactone (wishlist) leads, Bacdanol + Cardamom Oil RCO support. Milky-musk delta decalactone against bacdanol's sandalwood warmth.

accords.name: Sun-Warmed Grain Sack
accords.inspiration: A full sack, left in direct sun for the afternoon.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Gamma Nonalactone (Aldehyde C-18) leads, Bacdanol + Exaltolide Total support. Creamy gourmand against exaltolide's warmth — grain that's been sitting for hours.

accords.name: Combine Harvester Dust
accords.inspiration: The cloud a machine throws up behind it, visible for a mile.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cardamom Oil RCO leads, Coffee CO2 (10%) + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Spice and coffee against vanilla — dust, diesel and grain, all at once.

accords.name: Last Bale of the Season
accords.inspiration: The final one, tied off as the light goes.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) leads, Methyl Ionone Gamma + Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Hay-sweet coumarin settling into powder and moss as the day ends.

accords.name: Final Log of the Watch
accords.inspiration: The one you put on knowing it's the last for the night.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Guaiacol (1%) leads, Cedarwood support. Smoke against dry cedar — the fire's last real burst before it settles.

accords.name: Watchman's Pipe
accords.inspiration: Something to keep the hands busy through the cold hours.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Black Pepper Oil leads, Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Black pepper's bite against frankincense's cool smoke.

accords.name: Coals, Banked for Morning
accords.inspiration: Covered in ash to keep a low heat until dawn.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Guaiacol (1%) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Smoke folding into resin, the fire reduced to its slowest possible state.

accords.name: Spark on Wool
accords.inspiration: An ember that jumps and catches on a sleeve, brushed off in time.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Black Pepper Oil leads, Vetiver EO support. Pepper and root, black pepper oil against vetiver's own dry earth.

accords.name: Cardamom in the Kettle
accords.inspiration: Something hot to drink, to make the watch bearable.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cardamom Oil RCO leads, Black Pepper Oil support. Spice on spice, cardamom and black pepper both wide awake.

accords.name: Cold Hands, Warm Cup
accords.inspiration: The one comfort available at three in the morning.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cardamom Oil RCO leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Cardamom against vanilla — the closest this collection gets to sweetness.

accords.name: Smoke Hole in the Roof
accords.inspiration: Where what's left of the fire actually escapes.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Guaiacol (1%) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) + Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Smoke, cypriol and frankincense, all rising the same direction.

accords.name: Wolf Hour
accords.inspiration: The dead middle of the night, when the fire's at its weakest.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) + Oud Oliffac support. Resin and oud, low and animalic, the watch's darkest stretch.

accords.name: Ash and Resin
accords.inspiration: What's left once the flame itself is finally gone.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Guaiacol (1%) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Smoke settling into frankincense's own coolness, the fire now just a memory.

accords.name: First Light, Fire Still Going
accords.inspiration: Dawn arriving before the fire's fully out.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Black Pepper Oil leads, Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich + Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Black pepper brightening against bergamot, the first citrus this whole watch has seen.

accords.name: Fogged Glass Panes
accords.inspiration: Condensation thick enough to write your name in.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Floralozone leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Aldehydic air meeting hedione's own transparency — the glass itself, almost.

accords.name: Orchid House Humidity
accords.inspiration: The specific, heavy warmth the orchids are kept in.
accords.note_to_perfumer: PEME (Phenyl Ethyl Methyl Ether) leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Green-floral peme against hedione's own quiet lift.

accords.name: Tropical Leaf, Dripping
accords.inspiration: A single enormous leaf, still shedding water an hour after the last misting.
accords.note_to_perfumer: PEME (Phenyl Ethyl Methyl Ether) leads, Floralozone support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Peme's green-floral facet against floralozone's aerated top.

accords.name: Ylang Under Glass
accords.inspiration: A flower that would never survive outside this room.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Jasmine Sambac support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Ylang and jasmine, both fully tropical, both fully paired.

accords.name: Watering Can
accords.inspiration: Water poured slowly along a row of pots.
accords.note_to_perfumer: PEME (Phenyl Ethyl Methyl Ether) leads, Rose Wardia BM support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Peme's green-floral note against rose — the closest thing to an actual garden hose here.

accords.name: Condensation on the Roof
accords.inspiration: Drops forming on the glass overhead, ready to fall.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) leads, Jasmine Sambac support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Hedione and jasmine, quiet and a little heady at once.

accords.name: Overgrown Corner
accords.inspiration: The one bed nobody's pruned back in months.
accords.note_to_perfumer: PEME (Phenyl Ethyl Methyl Ether) leads, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol (PEA) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Peme against phenyl ethyl alcohol's own rose-adjacent softness.

accords.name: Heat Lamp Hum
accords.inspiration: The low mechanical sound that keeps this whole room alive.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Jasmine Sambac leads, Bacdanol support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Jasmine warmed by bacdanol's creamy sandalwood.

accords.name: Petals on Wet Slate
accords.inspiration: Fallen blooms, already starting to fade on the floor.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Rose against hedione, soft and a little transparent.

accords.name: Greenhouse at Closing Time
accords.inspiration: The last watering of the day, before the lights go off.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Floralozone leads, Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate + Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. The same aerated-green trio the courtyard rain uses, indoors this time.

accords.name: Raw Hide
accords.inspiration: Untreated skin, before any of the real work has started.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Civet (1%) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Civet at trace against labdanum's warmth — animalic, not yet leather.

accords.name: Tanning Vats
accords.inspiration: Where the hide actually becomes leather, over days.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cypriol (Nagarmotha) leads, Oud Oliffac support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Cypriol and oud, the two darkest materials in this palette, mutually reinforcing.

accords.name: Curing Salt
accords.inspiration: The first step, drawing out everything the hide doesn't need.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Civet (1%) leads, Oud Oliffac support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Civet's animalic edge against oud's own depth.

accords.note_to_perfumer: Black Currant Bud Absolute Replacer leads, Fructone + Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. The tart, sulphurous green of blackcurrant bud with pear sweetness beneath and bergamot opening it out.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Bruised Skins
accords.inspiration: Fruit that has been handled too much and is sweeter for it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Fructone leads, Gamma Undecalactone (Aldehyde C-14) support. Fructone's apple-pear against the fruity-floral lactone that makes stone fruit smell ripe rather than fresh.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Jam Pan
accords.inspiration: Sugar and fruit at the point where one becomes the other.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Methyl Anthranilate leads, Orange 10-fold Oil + Fructone support. Grape and orange over pear, the whole thing about to caramelise.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Banana Leaf Wrap
accords.inspiration: Fruit carried home in whatever was nearest.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Acetate leads, Fructone support. Benzyl acetate is banana and pear before it is anything floral; fructone doubles the pear.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Jasmine on the Post
accords.inspiration: A vine that got there first, still winning.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Acetate leads, Jasmine Sambac support. Benzyl acetate is jasmine's own cheap-and-cheerful cousin, so putting the real flower behind it reads as one plant, not two.

accords.name: Windfall in the Grass
accords.inspiration: What the birds got to before anyone else did.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Gamma Undecalactone (Aldehyde C-14) leads, Fructone + Benzyl Acetate support. The fruity lactone with pear underneath and banana on top — overripe, warm, and entirely honest about it.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Late Bunch
accords.inspiration: The one nobody could reach, left until it was almost wine.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Methyl Anthranilate leads, Orange 10-fold Oil support. Grape against orange — the sweetest, most childlike pairing in this whole palette.

accords.name: Vine Cut Back
accords.inspiration: Green stems and sap, everything fruiting finished for the year.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Black Currant Bud Absolute Replacer leads, Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich + Rose Wardia BM support. Tart green blackcurrant bud with bergamot and a rose edge — the arbour with the fruit taken out of it.

accords.name: Noon Row
accords.inspiration: Heat coming off the plants faster than the scent can leave them.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Lavandin Grosso leads, Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Lavandin is sharper and more camphorous than true lavender; coumarin's hay catches it before it turns medicinal.

accords.name: Cut and Drying
accords.inspiration: Rows laid flat, going from purple to grey over three days.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Lavandin Grosso leads, Linalyl Acetate + Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Lavandin over its own sweeter acetate, with bergamot keeping the top alive.

accords.name: Distillery Shed
accords.inspiration: Steam coming off the still, the whole harvest reduced to a litre.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Lavandin Grosso leads, Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich + Clary Sage Oil support. Lavender's green-herbal against clary sage's tea-tobacco warmth.

accords.name: Hay Barn Next Door
accords.inspiration: Not lavender at all, and part of the same afternoon.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) leads, Linalyl Acetate support. Coumarin and linalyl acetate — the hay-and-bergamot handshake every fougère is built on.

accords.name: Bee Line
accords.inspiration: Everything in the field doing the same job at once.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Linalool leads, Linalyl Acetate support. Soft floral linalool over its acetate, sweeter and rounder than the field itself.

accords.name: Stone Wall Edge
accords.inspiration: Where the rows stop and the hillside takes over.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Clary Sage Oil leads, Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Clary sage and bergamot, both green, neither sweet.

accords.name: Bundled and Hung
accords.inspiration: Tied in the doorway and left there until it forgets it was a flower.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Lavandin Grosso leads, Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Lavandin with coumarin and the benzoin that makes dried herbs smell like a cupboard rather than a field.

accords.name: Shaving Soap
accords.inspiration: The other place this plant has always lived.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Linalyl Acetate leads, Dihydromyrcenol + Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Lavender-bergamot over the soapy aldehyde that makes a barbershop a barbershop.

accords.name: Evening Cool
accords.inspiration: The scent finally arriving once the heat stops pushing it away.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Clary Sage Oil leads, Ambroxan (10% DPG) support. Clary sage against ambroxan's dry radiance — herbal, but with something warm behind it.

accords.name: Last of the Crop
accords.inspiration: One row left standing because nobody got to it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Linalool leads, Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Linalool and bergamot, the simplest and gentlest thing this field can smell of.

accords.name: Petals in the Copper
accords.inspiration: Half a field of flowers, packed into one vessel.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geraniol Extra leads, Rose Wardia BM + Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol (PEA) support. Geraniol is the rosy-green facet of a rose without the jam; phenyl ethyl alcohol is its honeyed petal. Both hang off the flower itself.

accords.name: First Run
accords.inspiration: The clearest water of the day, taken before anything else.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geraniol Extra leads, Rose Wardia BM + Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Rosy geraniol over the real flower with hedione's transparency holding it open.

accords.name: Honeyed Water
accords.inspiration: Sweetness that came out of the flower, not out of a jar.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol (PEA) leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Phenyl ethyl alcohol's honey-rose against benzoin's resin.

accords.name: Geranium Leaf
accords.inspiration: The leaf, which smells more of rose than most roses do.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geraniol Extra leads, Linalool + Petitgrain RC support. Geraniol with linalool's soft floral-citrus and petitgrain's green bitterness.

accords.name: Cooling Coil
accords.inspiration: Vapour turning back into something you can hold.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol (PEA) leads, Galaxolide (50%) support. Rose petal softness against galaxolide's clean cushion.

accords.name: Spent Petals
accords.inspiration: A whole harvest, used up and thrown in a heap out the back.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Patchouli support. Rose with patchouli's damp earth under it — the pile, not the flower.

accords.name: Bottled and Stoppered
accords.inspiration: Rose water put away for a year of cooking and washing.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) support. Rose and hedione, kept deliberately thin and clean.

accords.name: Morning Pick
accords.inspiration: Flowers cut before the sun can take anything out of them.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geraniol Extra leads, Rose Wardia BM support. Geraniol and rose, cool and green at the edges.

accords.name: Kitchen Shelf
accords.inspiration: Where the bottle actually ends up, next to the cardamom.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol (PEA) leads, Rose Wardia BM + Cardamom Oil RCO support. Rose-honey and rose, warmed by cardamom's green spice.

accords.name: Still Room Floor
accords.inspiration: Wet stone, spent flowers, and steam that never quite clears.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Patchouli + Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Rose over damp earth and moss — the room rather than the product.

accords.name: Screwpine in Flower
accords.inspiration: A smell most of the world has never met and half of India grew up on.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Cardamom Oil RCO support. Kewra attar is honeyed, hay-green, faintly medicinal, and used almost nowhere in this library — here it simply leads, with cardamom lifting it.

accords.name: Kewra and Saffron
accords.inspiration: The pairing that turns a rice pot into an occasion.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Safraleine support. Kewra's green honey against safraleine's saffron-leather. Both loud, both traditional, genuinely paired.

accords.name: Garden After Rain
accords.inspiration: Everything doubled in strength by the wet.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Rose Wardia BM support. Kewra over rose, with the flowers' own greenness pushed forward.

accords.name: Sherbet Stall
accords.inspiration: Kewra water, ice, and too much sugar.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Cardamom Oil RCO + Orange 10-fold Oil support. The attar with cardamom and orange — how it actually reaches most people.

accords.name: Wedding Tent Pole
accords.inspiration: Canvas, marigold, and whatever was sprayed on the guests.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Rose Wardia BM + Safraleine support. Kewra, rose and saffron — the full ceremonial triangle.

accords.name: Night Air Over the Beds
accords.inspiration: The hour the flowers stop holding back.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) + Jasmine Sambac support. Rose and jasmine at full strength, hedione holding the space between them.

accords.name: Hay and Honey
accords.inspiration: The part of this flower that isn't floral at all.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Kewra leads, Cardamom Oil RCO + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Kewra's hay facet met by coumarin's, and benzoin's sweetness underneath.

accords.name: Distiller's Hands
accords.inspiration: Whoever made the attar wears it for a week.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Safraleine leads, Bacdanol support. Saffron-leather and sandalwood — what's left on skin rather than in the bottle.

accords.name: Brass Sprinkler
accords.inspiration: The gulabdan, passed around at the door.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Rose Wardia BM leads, Cardamom Oil RCO support. Rose and cardamom, the two things in every welcome.

accords.name: Stored in the Almirah
accords.inspiration: A bottle kept so long it has become the cupboard's smell.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Safraleine leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Bacdanol support. Saffron and resin gone quiet, sandalwood holding them.

accords.name: Myrrh in the Scale Pan
accords.inspiration: Bitter, dark, and heavier in the hand than it looks.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Frankincense (Olibanum) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh resinoid is the bitter one — medicinal, balsamic, and far less used here than frankincense. Frankincense beside it is the classic pair.

accords.name: Opoponax Drawer
accords.inspiration: Sweet myrrh, kept separate from the bitter kind.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh with labdanum's warmth taking the edge off it.

accords.name: Frankincense Tears
accords.inspiration: Pale lumps that smell of lemon before they smell of church.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Frankincense (Olibanum) leads, Cedarwood support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Frankincense over dry cedar — cool, bright, and architectural.

accords.name: Gum Arabic Shelf
accords.inspiration: The odourless one, there to hold everything else together.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Benzyl benzoate is nearly odourless and hugely useful — here it carries benzoin and vanillin instead of hiding behind them.

accords.name: Dark Balsam Jar
accords.inspiration: Something halfway between a resin and a syrup.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Benzoin and labdanum with benzyl benzoate giving them room.

accords.name: Mortar of Resin
accords.inspiration: Ground fine, because it will not dissolve otherwise.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh and cypriol, both dark, both mineral.

accords.name: Censer in the Back Room
accords.inspiration: Kept burning so the shop always smells of its own stock.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Frankincense (Olibanum) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) + Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Frankincense, cypriol and labdanum moving together.

accords.name: Sealing Wax
accords.inspiration: Resin put to a use that has nothing to do with worship.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) + Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Benzoin and coumarin with benzyl benzoate's neutral sweetness.

accords.name: Bitter Tincture
accords.inspiration: A remedy nobody would take for pleasure.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Myrrh Resinoid leads, Frankincense (Olibanum) + Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Myrrh's medicinal bitterness against frankincense and cypriol.

accords.name: Closing the Shutters
accords.inspiration: Everything shut in together overnight.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Patina pulled toward the faded end — nothing here should read fresh. Labdanum and vanillin, the warmest corner of an otherwise cold shop.

accords.name: Bark Cracked Open
accords.inspiration: A quill snapped in half, and the whole room knows.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cinnamon Bark Oil leads, Clove Bud EO support. Cinnamon bark oil is hot, sharp and genuinely aldehydic at the top — clove beside it is the oldest spice pairing there is.

below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Sugar and Spice
accords.inspiration: The mixture waiting in a bowl before anything is baked.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cinnamon Bark Oil leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Cinnamon with vanillin and benzoin — sweet, hot, and completely unsubtle.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Orange Zest on the Board
accords.inspiration: Peel taken off in one piece, oil going everywhere.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cinnamon Bark Oil leads, Orange 10-fold Oil support. Cinnamon and orange, a pairing the material's own notes call out.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Proving Drawer
accords.inspiration: Warm, yeasted, and not yet anything.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Gamma Nonalactone (Aldehyde C-18) leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Milky gourmand lactone with vanilla — dough rather than cake.

accords.name: Clove Studded
accords.inspiration: Pushed into the fruit one at a time, for a smell more than a taste.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Clove Bud EO leads, Cinnamon Bark Oil + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Clove and cinnamon over benzoin's resin.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch
below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Coffee on the Counter
accords.inspiration: The pot that has been going since four in the morning.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Cinnamon Bark Oil support. Coffee CO2's bitter roast against cinnamon's heat.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Burnt Edge
accords.inspiration: The tray left in ninety seconds too long.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Guaiacol (1%) + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Coffee and vanilla with a phenolic smoke edge.

accords.name: Glaze Brushed On
accords.inspiration: Sugar syrup going onto something still too hot.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ethyl Maltol leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Ethyl maltol's candy sweetness held down by vanillin.

accords.name: Nutmeg Grater
accords.inspiration: A spice used in such small amounts it never runs out.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Nutmeg EO leads, Clove Bud EO + Cardamom Oil RCO support. Nutmeg's warm camphor-sweet wood with clove and cardamom.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Shop at Closing
accords.inspiration: Everything sold, and the smell of it still in the walls.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) + Cinnamon Bark Oil support. Benzoin and vanillin with cinnamon fading behind them.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Banana Custard Flower
accords.inspiration: A flower that smells like a dessert and a rubber glove at once.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Jasmine Sambac support. Ylang is creamy, banana-custard floral with clove depths — jasmine beside it is the pairing its own notes name first.

accords.name: Clove in the Petal
accords.inspiration: The spice that is genuinely inside the flower.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Clove Bud EO support. Ylang's own clove facet doubled by the real material.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Cream and Wood
accords.inspiration: The flower given something solid to stand on.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Bacdanol support. Ylang over bacdanol's milky sandalwood.

accords.name: Overripe and Lovely
accords.inspiration: Past its best and better for it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Gamma Undecalactone (Aldehyde C-14) support. Ylang with the fruity lactone that makes white flowers smell almost edible.

accords.name: Resin Under the Flower
accords.inspiration: Something sticky holding all that sweetness down.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Ylang and benzoin, warm and heavy together.

accords.name: Salicylate Haze
accords.inspiration: The blur that makes a big floral bearable.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Salicylate leads, Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate) + Ylang Ylang support. Benzyl salicylate is nearly odourless and does most of the work in every white floral ever made — here it sits with hedione and ylang and is allowed to.

accords.name: Night Jasmine Too
accords.inspiration: Two flowers competing over the same square metre.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Jasmine Sambac leads, Benzyl Salicylate support. Jasmine and benzyl salicylate, the classic sheer-white-floral construction.

accords.name: Aldehyde Lift
accords.inspiration: The trick that makes a flower arrive before you do.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Aldehyde C-10 (Decanal, 10%) leads, Ylang Ylang support. Aldehyde C-10 over ylang — mid-century, sharp, glamorous.

accords.name: Verandah Floorboards
accords.inspiration: Warm wood that has taken the flower's smell permanently.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Bacdanol leads, Exaltolide Total support. Sandalwood and musk with the flower gone quiet on top.

accords.name: Last Flower of the Season
accords.inspiration: One bloom left, doing the work of twenty.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ylang Ylang leads, Jasmine Sambac + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Ylang, jasmine and benzoin — everything at once, for the last time.

accords.name: First Roast
accords.inspiration: Beans going dark, twenty minutes before anyone is allowed in.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Guaiacol (1%) support. Coffee CO2 is bitter, smoky and faintly sulphurous; guaiacol's campfire phenol is the same smell taken further.

accords.name: Cardamom in the Pot
accords.inspiration: Ground in with the coffee, the way half the world drinks it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Cardamom Oil RCO support. Coffee and cardamom, a pairing the material's own notes list first.

accords.name: Grounds in the Bin
accords.inspiration: Wet, spent, and somehow better than the drink.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Patchouli support. Coffee over patchouli's damp earth.

accords.name: Milk Jug
accords.inspiration: Steamed, poured, and the only soft thing in the room.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Delta-Decalactone (wishlist) leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Milky delta decalactone with vanilla, no coffee at all.

accords.name: Sugar Bowl
accords.inspiration: Two spoons, because the roast is too dark otherwise.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Ethyl Maltol support. Coffee's bitterness against ethyl maltol's candy — the drink as most people actually take it.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Ink and Newsprint
accords.inspiration: The paper someone left folded on the table.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Coffee at trace reads as ink; cypriol's dry smoke finishes it.

accords.name: Wooden Counter
accords.inspiration: Forty years of spills, sanded back twice.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Coffee CO2 (10%) leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) + Cypriol (Nagarmotha) support. Coffee, benzoin and dry cypriol — the room rather than the cup.

accords.name: Nutmeg Shaker
accords.inspiration: Sitting by the till, used by almost nobody.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Nutmeg EO leads, Coffee CO2 (10%) support. Nutmeg's warm sweet spice with coffee behind it.

accords.name: Cinnamon Jar
accords.inspiration: The other shaker, used by everybody.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cinnamon Bark Oil leads, Coffee CO2 (10%) support. Cinnamon and coffee, hot and dark together.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Closing and Mopping
accords.inspiration: Wet floor, cold machine, the day finished.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Guaiacol (1%) leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) + Patchouli support. Smoke and damp earth with the roast almost gone.

accords.name: Shavings Underfoot
accords.inspiration: A floor nobody sweeps because of how it smells.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ebanol leads, Bacdanol support. Ebanol is the quieter, nuttier sandalwood — creamier than bacdanol and barely used here. The two together are one wood, not two.

accords.name: Milk and Wood
accords.inspiration: The dairy note that is genuinely inside sandalwood.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ebanol leads, Gamma Nonalactone (Aldehyde C-18) support. Ebanol with the milk lactone its own pairing list names.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Warm in the Hand
accords.inspiration: A block held long enough to take body heat.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ebanol leads, Exaltolide Total support. Ebanol and exaltolide — wood turning into skin.

accords.name: Chisel and Mallet
accords.inspiration: Cutting across the grain, which you are not supposed to do.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Bacdanol leads, Cardamom Oil RCO support. Sandalwood with cardamom's green lift.

accords.name: Sanded Smooth
accords.inspiration: Finished by hand until it stops catching the light.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ebanol leads, Bacdanol + Gamma Nonalactone (Aldehyde C-18) support. Two sandalwoods with a milky lactone between them.

formula.bench_warning: below MIN_WEIGHABLE (0.05 g) at 10.0 g batch — use a working dilution or a larger batch

accords.name: Prayer Bead String
accords.inspiration: Worn against the skin daily for thirty years.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Bacdanol leads, Exaltolide Total support. Sandalwood and musk, close and quiet.

accords.name: Oil Pressed from Offcuts
accords.inspiration: Nothing wasted, even the dust.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Bacdanol leads, Rose Wardia BM support. Sandalwood with rose — the mukhallat pairing, kept soft.

accords.name: Incense Stick Rolling
accords.inspiration: The other thing this shop makes.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Bacdanol leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) + Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Sandalwood, benzoin and a thread of labdanum.

accords.name: Cabinet of Finished Work
accords.inspiration: Closed, and quietly perfuming itself.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ebanol leads, Bacdanol + Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Ebanol and benzoin, sweet and woody and shut in.

accords.name: Carver's Apron

accords.name: Hedge Cut Back
accords.inspiration: Everything green, in a heap, in August.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) + Bergamot INDI (reconstitution) - dsm-firmenich support. Cut grass, bergamot and moss.

accords.name: Almost Odourless
accords.inspiration: The one that smells of nothing and changes everything.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Benzyl benzoate is faint, sweet-balsamic and nearly neutral — used twice in the whole library before this. Here it leads, with benzoin giving it something to carry.

accords.name: Vanilla Barrel
accords.inspiration: Sweetness by the gallon.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Benzyl benzoate holding vanillin instead of thinning it.

accords.name: Tonka Sack
accords.inspiration: Hay, almond and something faintly medicinal.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Benzyl benzoate and coumarin, both quiet, both sweet.

accords.name: Labdanum Block
accords.inspiration: Scraped off a goat and worth every rupee.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) support. Benzyl benzoate carrying labdanum's leathery sweetness.

accords.name: Peru and Tolu
accords.inspiration: Two balsams nobody outside this room can tell apart.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Benzoin and labdanum with vanillin between them.

accords.name: Resin Dust on the Floor
accords.inspiration: Swept into corners, still sweet.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) leads, Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) + Methyl Ionone Gamma support. Benzoin, coumarin and a powdery ionone.

accords.name: Warm Store Room
accords.inspiration: Kept above freezing so nothing sets solid.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) leads, Ambroxan (10% DPG) support. Labdanum and ambroxan, warm and radiant.

accords.name: Cracked Open Barrel
accords.inspiration: The whole year's stock, in one breath.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) leads, Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) + Ethylene Brassylate support. Benzoin, vanillin and ethylene brassylate's sweet musk.

accords.name: Sweet Musk Corner
accords.inspiration: Where the fixatives are kept.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Ethylene Brassylate leads, Benzoin Resinoid 70 DEP (diluted 50% in BB) support. Ethylene brassylate with benzoin — musk that is genuinely sweet.

accords.name: Locked for Winter
accords.inspiration: Nothing moves in or out until spring.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Benzyl Benzoate leads, Labdanum Resinoid (50% in BB) + Vanillin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Benzyl benzoate, labdanum and vanillin, shut in together.

accords.name: Baked Earth
accords.inspiration: Ground that has had no water for two months.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Geosmin (0.1% working dilution) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Mitti attar is baked clay and wet dust — the genuine article behind every petrichor accord, and used barely at all here. Geosmin sharpens it.

accords.name: First Drops on Dust
accords.inspiration: The smell arriving a second before the rain does.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Mitti with damp moss beneath.

accords.name: Vetiver at the Edge
accords.inspiration: Roots holding the yard together.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Vetiver EO support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Mitti and vetiver, both root, both earth.

accords.name: Clay Pot Drying
accords.inspiration: Thrown this morning, fired next week.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Cedarwood support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Mitti over cedar's dry wood.

accords.name: Wet Through
accords.inspiration: An hour in, and everything has changed colour.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geosmin (0.1% working dilution) leads, Patchouli support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Geosmin and patchouli at full strength.

accords.name: Puddle in the Hollow
accords.inspiration: Water finding the one dip in the yard.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geosmin (0.1% working dilution) leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) + Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Geosmin, moss and cut grass.

accords.name: Steam Off the Ground
accords.inspiration: Heat leaving as vapour the moment it rains.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Geosmin (0.1% working dilution) leads, Floralozone support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Earth with floralozone's aerated top.

accords.name: Neem Over the Wall
accords.inspiration: The tree that shades half of it.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Petitgrain RC leads, Vetiver EO support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Green petitgrain and vetiver, bitter and rooty.

accords.name: Cattle and Straw
accords.inspiration: The other half of what a yard actually smells of.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) + Coumarin (40% DPG — migrate, see spec) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Earth and moss with hay behind it.

accords.name: Dry Again by Evening
accords.inspiration: Two hours of rain, gone by dark.
accords.note_to_perfumer: Attar Mitti leads, Cedarwood + Peatmoss (Veramoss equivalent, 10% DPG) support. Built wet: keep the damp/green facets forward. Mitti, cedar and moss, the water already leaving.
